_doc: The Empty's frame (scripts/match/empty_frame.gd, docs/CHARACTER_CREATOR.md): each body slider 0..1 maps onto [lo, hi] for the body's sex (f / m), a factor on the shape. Shoulder and hip ranges do not overlap between the sexes, so a woman always reads narrower on top and wider below than any man, and no slider leaves the range the outfits are built for.
